steps.title: Open the home page
Navigation, search, sorting and filters are usable; products are listed

specs.title: TC02 Return to the home page from a product page

steps.title: Open the home page and click product #1
Click "Home" in the navigation bar
Back on the home page: product grid and filters are shown again
Open Categories > Hand Tools
Category title and its products are shown
Open the home page
Home page: logo, navigation, sidebar headings, search button and product images
Open the first product: the related products heading
Search for "hammer"
The search term is shown and every result name contains "hammer"
Search for "Claw Hammer"
The product is in the results with a price
Search for "NoSuchTool12345"
A "no products found" message is shown and the grid is empty
Choose "Price (Low - High)"
Products are sorted by price, ascending

specs.title: TC08 Product details match the search result

steps.title: Search for "hammer" and note the price of "Thor Hammer"
Open the product: name and price match; quantity and "Add to cart" are usable
Move the upper handle of "Price Range" down to 30
Every listed product costs between 1 and 30
